study.question: Does the auxiliary-derived batch-global orientation bit contribute to the fixed-carrier shared-context intervention, after holding its auxiliary-dependent line, native norm, validity gate and external sign fixed?
study.hypothesis: The fixed carrier may aid optimization without needing the transported sign bit from the auxiliary-derived paired tangent Q. The latest fixed oriented negative trial has validation click AUC 0.6688558744746697 and positive 0.6685951091914883, versus paired-tangent bridges 0.6679704658577205 and 0.6683166124016482. Their sign ordering reverses across line source. This is a single frozen-seed observation after extensive validation search, not causal or repeated support. Strip only s(Q) from R=s(Q)V by canonicalizing R with the inherited first-max-absolute-pivot rule, yielding V wherever R is valid. If both canonical cells retain the oriented performance envelope, the bit is unnecessary within this constrained intervention; auxiliary information still remains in norm, excluded subspace and gate.

nearest_work.difference: Exact starting source hash b56af9df6f5b9db7069e0e3ca0510e37ffb04d8db5d1a9c21d7e052e444b1738 verified against candidate.py and supplied ancestor. It transfers -s(Q)V; proposed canonical-negative transfers -V with the identical zero gate, carrier, projection and radius. Forward model and losses are retained.

Earlier canonicalization stripped the sign of the auxiliary-derived Q line, not the fixed carrier line V. Its positive/negative AUC 0.6681237732153242/0.6679547103280907 does not identify the effect of s(Q) on V. These trials are historical trajectory evidence, not matched controls for this study.

Joint click/auxiliary cotangent collection; occupied-row FP64 centering; centered click K, auxiliary native orthogonal O; paired reassignment and tangent Q; modular-coordinate carrier projected out of K and O; norm restoration, 1e-6 tangent gate and first-max-pivot canonicalization.
Fixed inputs, official_offline history, masks, sample identities, one-pass training, seed, optimizers, BF16, clipping, full validation and closed holdout.
study.proposed_difference: Compute fixed_canonical=_canonical_tangent(fixed_oriented) in every cell, where fixed_oriented=s(Q)V is the existing helper output. Select +/-fixed_canonical for the two candidate cells and +/-fixed_oriented for replay bridges. Canonicalizing R removes its one transported bit while preserving its line, norm and exact zero support at fixed gradients; unlike canonicalizing the un-gated carrier, it retains Q=0 and carrier-degeneracy gates. No parameters, buffers, RNG, extra model pass or labels in forward are introduced. This is a surrogate VJP intervention, not a claimed scalar objective. Geometry statements apply before the inherited cast, embedding-ID scatter, optimizer and clipping.
predictions: At identical synthetic gradients and occupied masks, oriented R and canonical V have equal norm and zero support; V is invariant to R reversal and R=s(Q)V on nonzero entries, up to FP64 numerical tolerances. V is zero on empty-history rows and centered/orthogonal to K and O before casting. Simultaneous auxiliary-gradient reversal makes R odd and V even away from ties/gates. Both external signs execute in every cell.

Primary performance contrasts are canonical-negative minus oriented-negative and canonical-positive minus oriented-positive. Secondary interaction is (canonical-positive minus canonical-negative) minus (oriented-positive minus oriented-negative). Report every cell and contrast; do not interpret the maximum over signs alone as evidence for bit removal.

If the bit is unnecessary, both matched canonical-minus-oriented AUC contrasts should be nonnegative under later paired repetitions, rather than an apparent gain from selecting only one sign. A reproducible deficit for a matched sign establishes context-dependent utility of the transported bit; opposite-signed effects imply interaction, not universal utility or harm.

Oriented-positive and oriented-negative bridges should reproduce g3-r0052-fixed_line_positive (0.6685951091914883) and g3-r0052-fixed_line_negative (0.6688558744746697) under the fixed seed. Their helper selection is unchanged. Changed bridges suspend performance attribution pending diagnosis.

Parameter counts remain 32192421 total/31793216 embedding/399205 dense, inference graph is unchanged, and only a common training-backward canonicalization is added. Measure all-task AUC/Logloss, memory, allocated GPU/wall cost, processed examples, inference throughput and latency; do not infer efficiency from source operations alone.
falsifiers: A reliable matched canonical deficit falsifies the claim that the bit can be discarded without cost for that sign; if deficits occur for both signs across paired seeds, abandon sign-bit removal as a useful intervention here.
If canonical and oriented results are indistinguishable within paired-seed/user-cluster uncertainty, do not claim bit utility, improvement or novelty. One seed only yields a local observation.

Failure of forward/buffer/private-gradient parity, unchanged bridge replay, equal norm/gates, empty-row handling, canonical reversal invariance, or pre-cast geometry prevents causal interpretation. An unavailable diagnostic is missing evidence rather than a passed check.

A favorable canonical result does not falsify useful auxiliary supervision: auxiliary magnitude, O exclusion, occupancy, Q-dependent validity and auxiliary private losses remain. A future matched auxiliary-independent radius/subspace control is needed for that stronger question.
alternative_explanations: The strongest latest trial is selected from many validation comparisons at one seed; small AUC differences can reflect seed dependence or adaptive validation selection. Deterministic replay is not independent repetition.
The fixed carrier depends on arbitrary row/coordinate ordering. Its canonical direction is not semantically positive or isotropic noise; sign effects may be coordinate artifacts.
Carrier direction still depends on click K and native auxiliary O through projection, norm and validity, even when s(Q) is removed. This experiment isolates one binary channel only.

Mixed precision, repeated-ID sparse scatter, adaptive optimization and dense clipping can alter geometry and training trajectories; row-space orthogonality does not imply orthogonal parameter updates.

Historical sign reversal and aggregation branches were unsuccessful or numerically unstable: g3-r0039-centered_replay fell to 0.6676314512972833 versus the earlier 0.668362209030126 centered branch, and g3-r0041-collected_task32 had 0.6674577109894665 versus float64 0.6682972490126902. Keep the inherited joint FP64 collection, freeze operation order and use exact bridges. All latest executions succeeded, but candidate_diagnostics were not requested, so geometry remains unmeasured.

The click-only/context-blocked reference AUC 0.6678548720585206 and rolled-label control 0.6674639465810746 support investigating informative auxiliary gradients, but differ from the new cotangent intervention and cannot replace its matched controls. Auxiliary label semantics and official_offline maturity limit production transfer.
